usage: The top 25 available players per position by rostered percentage, with acquisition cost, bye week, injury badge and upcoming opponents already attached. This is a trimmed view of available_players.json for when a report needs candidates rather than the whole ~850-player pool. Availability still comes from the same snapshot, and player_index.json remains the authority on ownership. acquisition is FREE AGENT ($0, instant) or WAIVERS (needs a FAAB bid, processing at waiver_process_ct).
